components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it must be
            one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and, together with the last name, composes the
            returned 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'; when present it is normalized
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations
            expanded) and, together with 'addressLine2', composes the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 3'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields
            are supplied it is composed from them (the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with spaces, dashes
            and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in
            E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no country code is
            given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city whose region is known, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it determines the
            owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a household),
            which would otherwise be rejected as a duplicate. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans — the '+' country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' — REGION is
                the region derived from the postcode, FY the two-digit fiscal year of the
                registrationDate, HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone plus lastName, and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household — owners
                with the same last name and postcode. Derived deterministically from those two
                fields, so household members share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last
                name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this
                owner's registration day at the moment it was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                at the moment it was created (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared its last name and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match
                that is not a hard duplicate), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched on last name and
                postcode at the moment it was created (see 'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when
                there was no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is
                named by the calendar year it ends in, so 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points — starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is
                present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus
                3 when tenure is at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints —
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's canonical region — the REGION segment of the memberId,
                derived from the postcode range (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the
                pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or null when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel — 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners
                are duplicates only when their whole identity key matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band on their registrationDate, derived from birthDate —
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 or over). Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record, and
                the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks then ignore it.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

All tests pass and the build is green. Here's what I implemented.

## Summary

The spec asks for `riskFlag` on an owner to be `true` when any of three signals hold. Two of those signals already existed in the create pipeline as stored owner state; the third ("disposable-adjacent" email) was new. I kept each piece in its natural home rather than growing a catch-all.

**1. `OwnerEmails` — the email rule set (`rest/function/owner/OwnerEmails.java`)**
Added `isDisposableAdjacent(email)`: a domain that shares a known disposable provider's second-level label (e.g. `mailinator.net`, `sub.mailinator.com`) without being an outright disposable domain (those are already rejected 400 at create, so a *stored* email is never fully disposable — adjacency is the meaningful signal here). The adjacent-label set is derived from the existing `DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS` so the two never drift. Promoted the class to `public` (matching the sibling `OwnerTelephones`, already used cross-package by the mapper).

**2. `OwnerMapper` — the derived response fields (`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`)**
Added a small `riskFlag(owner)` method that ORs the three signals, reusing what already exists:
- possible duplicate → the existing `possibleDuplicate(owner)` (`possibleDuplicateOf != null`)
- city over soft capacity → the stored `capacityWarning` flag (set at creation by `AssignOwnerCapacityWarning` for cities holding 40–49 owners)
- disposable-adjacent email → `OwnerEmails.isDisposableAdjacent`

`riskFlag` is a pure derived field like `possibleDuplicate` — computed at mapping time, no new DB column.

**3. `openapi.yml`** — declared `riskFlag` as a `readOnly` boolean on the `Owner` schema (DTOs are generated from this spec at build), so it serializes as `$.riskFlag`.

The acceptance test (`coreRiskFlagFalseNormally`, which creates a clean owner — no duplicate, no email, unique city — and asserts `riskFlag` is `false`) passes, as does the full suite (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
